content.name: Ben Papadopoulos
content.title: Store Manager
content.summary: Store manager with nine years in Adelaide retail across footwear, surf and fresh food. Leads a $12m independent grocery and liquor store with 48 team members, where new rostering and fresh-department changes lifted gross margin by 2.4 points.

experience.title: Store Manager
bullets: Lead a $12m independent supermarket with an attached bottle shop, managing 48 team members across fresh, grocery, deli and liquor.
Lifted gross margin from 27.1% to 29.5% by renegotiating local produce supply and trimming slow-moving grocery lines by 900 SKUs.
Moved rostering to Deputy with forecast-based shifts, keeping wages under 11% of sales while meeting award and break requirements.
Keep the liquor licence compliant, with all bottle-shop staff holding current RSA and refusal logs reviewed weekly.

experience.title: Store Manager
bullets: Managed a beachside store with $2.6m turnover and 14 staff, most of them casual and under 25.
Added board hire and lessons with a local surf school, bringing in $190,000 a year in new revenue.
Ran stocktakes with variance under 0.8% three years running.

experience.title: Assistant Store Manager
bullets: Supported the manager of a CBD footwear store and ran the floor on late-night trading and weekends.
Introduced a shoe-care add-on routine at the counter that took accessory attachment from 12% to 26%.
Trained 10 new casuals a year on POS, lay-bys and returns under consumer law.

education.details: Completed part-time while managing a store.
